name: PingNode
label: Ping
description: Sends a message to determine whether a remote computer is accessible over the network.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: HostName
fields.label: Host name
fields.description: The host name or IP address to ping.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.label: Timeout
fields.description: The maximum time (in milliseconds) to wait for a response.

fields.name: PingResult
fields.label: Ping Result
fields.description: The status of the ping message (success or failure).

fields.name: RoundTripTime
fields.label: Round Trip Time
fields.description: The number of milliseconds taken for the Ping to complete.
